from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,hashlib
root=Path('/Users/ifioravanti/github/ds4');p=Path('/private/tmp/q2-mtp-next')
helper='\nstatic void qwen4_round3_dump(uint32_t kind, uint32_t pos, uint32_t rows, const float *logits) {\n    const char *path = getenv("DS4_ROUND3_LOGITS");\n    if (!path || !logits) return;\n    static FILE *fp;\n    if (!fp) fp = fopen(path, "wb");\n    const uint32_t header[] = {kind, pos, rows, DS4_N_VOCAB};\n    if (!fp || fwrite(header, sizeof(header), 1, fp) != 1 ||\n        fwrite(logits, sizeof(float), (size_t)rows * DS4_N_VOCAB, fp) != (size_t)rows * DS4_N_VOCAB ||\n        fflush(fp) != 0) { fprintf(stderr, "round3 logit dump failed\\n"); abort(); }\n}\n'
manifest={}
for cfg in ['baseline','candidate']:
 src=(p/'baseline.c' if cfg=='baseline' else root/'ds4.c').read_text()
 src=src.replace('static bool qwen4_graph_forward_tokens(',helper+'\nstatic bool qwen4_graph_forward_tokens(',1)
 anchor='    if (ok) g->pos += T;\n'
 assert src.count(anchor)==1
 src=src.replace(anchor,'    if (ok && logits_out) qwen4_round3_dump(0, pos0, all_rows ? T : 1u, logits_out);\n'+anchor)
 anchor='        if (ok && draft_out) *draft_out = sample_argmax(dst, DS4_N_VOCAB);\n'
 assert src.count(anchor)==1
 src=src.replace(anchor,'        if (ok) qwen4_round3_dump(1, idx, 1u, dst);\n'+anchor)
 if cfg=='candidate':
  anchor='        if (ok) *draft_out = token;\n'
  assert src.count(anchor)==1
  extra="""        if (ok && getenv("DS4_ROUND3_LOGITS")) {
            if (!ds4_gpu_tensor_read(g->logits, 0, g->host_logits, (uint64_t)DS4_N_VOCAB * sizeof(float))) abort();
            qwen4_round3_dump(1, idx, 1u, g->host_logits);
            if (sample_argmax(g->host_logits, DS4_N_VOCAB) != token) abort();
        }
"""
  src=src.replace(anchor,anchor+extra)
 source=p/f'{cfg}-diag.c';obj=p/f'{cfg}-diag.o';binary=p/('ds4-diag-base' if cfg=='baseline' else 'ds4-diag')
 source.write_text(src)
 compile=['cc','-O3','-ffast-math','-g','-mcpu=native','-Wall','-Wextra','-std=c99','-I.','-c',str(source),'-o',str(obj)]
 subprocess.run(compile,cwd=root,check=True)
 objs=['ds4_cli.o','ds4_help.o','ds4_gpu_args.o','ds4_prompt_prefix.o','linenoise.o','ds4_image.o','ds4_distributed.o','ds4_tp.o','ds4_ssd.o',str(p/'baseline-host.o') if cfg=='baseline' else 'ds4_metal.o','ds4_layer_pack.o']
 link=['cc','-o',str(binary),str(obj),*objs,'-lm','-pthread','-framework','Foundation','-framework','Metal']
 subprocess.run(link,cwd=root,check=True)
 manifest[cfg]={'compile':compile,'link':link,'source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'binary_sha256':hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
(p/'diagnostic-build.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+'\n')

import subprocess,pathlib,os,json,hashlib,struct,array,math,re
p=pathlib.Path('/private/tmp/q2-mtp-next')
base=['-m','/Users/ifioravanti/models/qwen38-q2down-experiment/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-IQ2XXSImatrix-Q2KDownPad768-MTP.gguf','--ple','/Users/ifioravanti/models/qwen38-q4k-imatrix/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-PLE-Q4_1.gguf','--metal','-c','32768','--nothink','--mtp','--mtp-timing']
prompt=['-p','Explain how a computer sends a web request over TCP and receives the response. Write four clear paragraphs for a programmer learning networking.']
cases={'greedy':[*prompt,'-n','128','--temp','0'], 'exact':[*prompt,'-n','128','--temp','0.7','--top-p','0.8','--seed','123','--mtp-exact-sampling'], 'long': ['--prompt-file','/private/tmp/q2-mtp-next/prompt16k.txt','-n','64','--temp','0']}
for n in [1,2,3]: cases[f'budget{n}']=[*prompt,'-n',str(n),'--temp','0']
report={'cases':{},'commands':[]}
for case,opts in cases.items():
 records=[]
 for cfg in ['baseline','candidate']:
  env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith('DS4_')}
  trace=p/f'{case}-{cfg}.f32';env['DS4_ROUND3_LOGITS']=str(trace);env['DS4_QWEN4_SPEC_TRACE']='1'
  env['DS4_METAL_QWEN4_SOURCE']=str(p/'baseline.metal') if cfg=='baseline' else str(pathlib.Path('metal/qwen4.metal').resolve())
  cmd=[str(p/('ds4-diag-base' if cfg=='baseline' else 'ds4-diag')),*base,*opts]
  report['commands'].append(cmd)
  r=subprocess.run(cmd,env=env,capture_output=True,check=True)
  (p/f'{case}-{cfg}.log').write_bytes(r.stderr);(p/f'{case}-{cfg}.stdout').write_bytes(r.stdout)
  counters=re.findall(rb'([0-9]+) verify cycles, ([0-9]+) drafts accepted',r.stderr)
  b=trace.read_bytes();offset=0;vectors=0; kinds={}
  while offset<len(b):
   kind,pos,rows,vocab=struct.unpack_from('<4I',b,offset);offset+=16
   n=rows*vocab; floats=array.array('f');floats.frombytes(b[offset:offset+4*n]);offset+=4*n
   assert len(floats)==n and all(math.isfinite(x) for x in floats)
   vectors+=rows;kinds[kind]=kinds.get(kind,0)+rows
  assert offset==len(b)
  records.append({'output_sha256':hashlib.sha256(r.stdout).hexdigest(),'logits_sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),'vectors':vectors,'kinds':kinds,'accepted':[[int(a),int(c)] for a,c in counters],'trace_sha256':hashlib.sha256(b'\n'.join(x for x in r.stderr.splitlines() if x.startswith(b'ds4: spec pos'))).hexdigest()})
 assert records[0]==records[1],(case,records)
 report['cases'][case]=records[0];print(case,records[0],flush=True)
report['source_sha256']={str(f):hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for f in [p/'candidate-diag.c',p/'baseline-host.m',pathlib.Path('ds4_metal.m'),p/'ds4-diag',p/'ds4-diag-base']}
(p/'diagnostics.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')

import os,subprocess,pathlib,re,json,hashlib
p=pathlib.Path('/private/tmp/q2-mtp-next')
cmd=['./ds4','-m','/Users/ifioravanti/models/qwen38-q2down-experiment/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-IQ2XXSImatrix-Q2KDownPad768-MTP.gguf','--ple','/Users/ifioravanti/models/qwen38-q4k-imatrix/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-PLE-Q4_1.gguf','--metal','-c','8192','-n','256','--nothink','--temp','0','--mtp','--mtp-timing','-p','Explain how a computer sends a web request over TCP and receives the response. Write four clear paragraphs for a programmer learning networking.']
records=[]
for rep in range(2):
 for nsg in ([0,1,2,3] if rep==0 else [3,2,1,0]):
  env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith('DS4_')}
  env['DS4_QWEN4_MOE_TOKEN_PAIR']=str(nsg)
  r=subprocess.run(cmd,env=env,capture_output=True,check=True)
  (p/f'pair-{nsg}-{rep}.log').write_bytes(r.stderr)
  (p/f'pair-{nsg}-{rep}.stdout').write_bytes(r.stdout)
  rate=re.search(rb'generation: ([0-9.]+) t/s',r.stderr).group(1).decode()
  rec={'nsg':nsg,'rep':rep,'tps':float(rate),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(r.stdout).hexdigest()}
  records.append(rec); print(rec,flush=True)
(p/'pair-sweep.json').write_text(json.dumps(records,indent=2))
